system.description: An armored squire or experienced commoner looking to advance.
system.notes:
Normal | Standard

An armored squire or experienced commoner looking to advance. Motives & Tactics: Gain glory, keep order, make alliances

Difficulty: 13 | Thresholds: 8/12 | HP: 4 | Stress: 3

ATK: +1 | Weapon: Very Close | 1d8+2 physical

Experience: —

Features

Reinforce - Action: Mark a Stress to move into Melee range of an ally and make a standard attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage and the ally can clear a Stress.

Veteran’s Loyalty - Reaction: When the Soldier is within Very Close range of an ally who would take damage, you can mark a Stress to move into Melee range of them and take the damage instead.
